legacyComparisonRequirement: Attach archived current-renderer captures and accepted comparison statuses for the same scenes before marking visual-improvement complete.

captures.label: Menu Ready
captures.criteria: WebGPU-ready menu, dense controls, readable modal surface.

currentRendererComparison.note: WebGPU menu preserves the current shell readability while adding explicit WebGPU-ready capability status.

captures.label: Unsupported WebGPU
captures.criteria: Unsupported browsers block renderer launch with useful text.
captures.evidence: WebGPU unavailable: WebGPU support was disabled for this verification run. The WebGPU build requires a browser and GPU adapter that expose WebGPU.

currentRendererComparison.note: The current renderer had no unsupported-WebGPU state; WebGPU is better because it blocks launch with a clear capability failure instead of entering an unusable renderer.

captures.label: Battle Max Crowd
captures.criteria: 30k raw-WebGPU crowd, Aegean haze, field-aware coast, warm terrain, skinned soldier material lighting, team colors, HUD composition.
captures.evidence: 30000 soldiers; renderer webgpu; drawCalls 1; aegean-sky-haze; field-aware coast; warm/cool skinned material grade

currentRendererComparison.note: WebGPU renders 30k soldiers versus the archived current renderer's 21.2k, keeps terrain/water/HUD readable, and uses far-view impostors for hardware performance headroom.

captures.label: Battle Selection DPR2
captures.criteria: Retina/DPR2 selection, order feedback, feathered shore, lit skinned silhouettes, minimap, unit cards.
captures.evidence: dpr2 selection; 2840 soldiers; renderer webgpu; aegean-sky-haze; feathered shore; lit skinned silhouettes

currentRendererComparison.note: Reopened after visual review. The archived current renderer fails to show all units, while WebGPU does render more units. The random frozen-overlay straight-line artifacts and hard square terrain artifacts have been addressed, but this capture remains pending until selected-unit readability, terrain feature fidelity, and old-renderer caveats are reviewed side by side.

captures.label: Campaign Whole Map
captures.criteria: Parchment map, territory, roads, water, clouds, WebGPU glyph labels.

currentRendererComparison.note: WebGPU campaign overview is visibly better: parchment/painted-chart treatment, stronger sea lanes, clearer faction washes, and large engraved labels.

Reopened after visual review: the WebGPU close zoom is not equal-or-better yet. The latest metric improved after fixing the black terrain and restoring label icons, but it still needs the previous 3D city/town, army, road, tree, terrain, font, icon, and marker language ported before release acceptance.

captures.label: Campaign Battle Handoff
captures.criteria: Campaign encounter launches a WebGPU battle with campaign return UI.
captures.evidence: 840 campaign battle soldiers; renderer webgpu; aegean-sky-haze; WebGPU terrain

currentRendererComparison.note: WebGPU handoff battle preserves the campaign return surface and improves performance with the same battle UI/readability contract.
